statistic: Mean of two per-process medians per ABBA state; microseconds per complete query. Raw samples and paired medians remain available. These are observations, not confidence intervals.

correctness.policy: Every SQL record uses the selected API. Query collection is external for every record. No failure allowlist, mixed API routing or un-authored skips are accepted.

diagnostics.note: Direct diagnostic observations are single before/final processes. Global generated-method sharing and exact pool isolation are asserted separately from timing.
